text:
Ajay: Starting canary deploy for release v2.14.3 -> eu-west. 10% traffic for 15m. DeployBot, kick off healthwatch. /cc @Maria @Kevin
DeployBot: Deploy started: release=v2.14.3 env=eu-west traffic=10% window=15m canary_id=cb-1717001234
ObservabilityBot: SLO snapshot @start: embed_p95=82ms (target 100ms), errors_5m=0.3% (target 0.5%), token_rate=1.2k rps. Dashboards: https://console.redwood/s/dash/1717001234
Maria: seeing a small p95 bump on /generate-embeds to ~210ms from a subset of hosts, not all. No 5xx yet. logs: ```host=eu-west-2a service=embed latency=210ms```
Kevin: Can we pin traffic to the older model variant for embeds? We have fallback rule for model:v2.14.2-quant. If risk increases, prefer pin.
Tara: Reminder: rollback threshold = p95 > 300ms OR 5xx > 0.8% sustained for 2m. Also watch mem pressure on gpu-pool-3.
Ajay: rolling hold for 2m to observe. @DeployBot pause-traffic 10% -> 5%
DeployBot: pause executed, new traffic=5%
ObservabilityBot: 2m snapshot: embed_p95=195ms, errors_5m=0.45%, mem_gpu=68% on gpu-pool-3. No 5xx spike.
Maria: telemetry shows KV cache miss rate up on some hosts — likely cold cache due to quant change, correlates with the higher tail latencies.
Kevin: OK, let's pin embed-route to v2.14.2-quant for canary traffic. config snippet: ```route "embed" -> model:v2.14.2-quant if canary==true```
Tara: +1. After pin, monitor p95 and 5xx for 5m before any further ramp.
Ajay: executing pin. @DeployBot apply-route-pin canary embed->v2.14.2-quant
DeployBot: route pin applied. canary traffic still 5%
ObservabilityBot: next snapshot (5m after): embed_p95=92ms, errors_5m=0.22%, mem_gpu=63% — back within SLO :thumbsup:
Ajay: unpause and ramp to 25% over 3m. Will record notes for the release: pinned embed route during canary due to KV miss-induced tail latency. Thanks everyone, closing thread in 30m.
